data.title: Check Washing — Altered Check Mobile Deposit with Duplicate or MICR Inconsistency
data.description: Detects mobile deposits of potentially washed or altered checks by identifying two key indicators: (1) the same check number deposited at multiple financial institutions within a short window, indicating duplicate deposit fraud, and (2) check amounts inconsistent with the MICR (Magnetic Ink Character Recognition) line data, suggesting the payee and amount fields were chemically washed and rewritten while the MICR line was preserved. FinCEN data shows check fraud SARs surged 200%+ from 2021-2023, driven by USPS mail theft and the ease of mobile deposit. Washed checks deposited via mobile apps exploit the lag between deposit and check clearing under Reg CC funds availability requirements. The Recorded Future 2025 report documented a geographic shift in stolen check activity toward the Midwest and suburban/rural USPS routes.

detection.condition: selection AND (filter_duplicate_check OR filter_micr_mismatch) AND filter_account_age

enrichment_required.source: Cross-institution duplicate check detection consortium or internal duplicate check database
Comparison of written/printed check amount against MICR-encoded amount

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Check Washing — Altered Check Mobile Deposit
// Detects duplicate deposits across institutions or MICR amount mismatches
(deposit_channel="mobile" OR deposit_channel="remote_deposit_capture")
account_age_days<30
(check_number_deposit_count>=2 OR micr_amount_match="false")
| amount_micr_delta := check_amount - micr_encoded_amount
| deposits_from_device := count(account_id, as=deposits_from_device_count, field=device_fingerprint)
| groupBy(check_number, function=[
    collect([account_id, check_amount, micr_encoded_amount, amount_micr_delta,
             deposit_date, device_fingerprint, depositing_institution_id,
             account_open_date, check_number_deposit_count])
  ])
| sort(check_number_deposit_count, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Check Washing — Altered Check Mobile Deposit")`
`comment("Detects duplicate check deposits or MICR line inconsistencies on mobile deposits to new accounts")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:check_processing
  (deposit_channel="mobile" OR deposit_channel="remote_deposit_capture")
| eval account_age_days = round((now() - strptime(account_open_date, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400)
| where account_age_days < 30
| stats count AS deposit_count dc(depositing_institution_id) AS institution_count
    values(check_amount) AS amounts values(depositing_institution_id) AS institutions
    values(device_fingerprint) AS devices
    BY check_number
| eval amount_micr_delta = check_amount - micr_encoded_amount
| eval risk_score = case(
    institution_count > 1 AND abs(amount_micr_delta) > 0, "critical",
    institution_count > 1, "high",
    abs(amount_micr_delta) > 500, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| where deposit_count > 1 OR abs(amount_micr_delta) > 0
| table check_number, deposit_count, institution_count, amounts,
        institutions, devices, amount_micr_delta, risk_score
| sort - risk_score
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Check Washing — Altered Check Mobile Deposit
-- Detects duplicate deposits across institutions or MICR amount mismatches
WITH deposit_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    d.check_number,
    d.account_id,
    d.check_amount,
    d.micr_encoded_amount,
    ABS(d.check_amount - d.micr_encoded_amount) AS amount_micr_delta,
    d.deposit_date,
    d.device_fingerprint,
    d.depositing_institution_id,
    a.account_open_date,
    DATEDIFF(DAY, a.account_open_date, d.deposit_date) AS account_age_days,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.check_number) AS check_deposit_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.depositing_institution_id) OVER (PARTITION BY d.check_number) AS institution_count
  FROM mobile_deposits d
  JOIN accounts a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE d.deposit_channel IN ('mobile', 'remote_deposit_capture')
    AND d.deposit_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, CURRENT_DATE)
)
SELECT *
FROM deposit_analysis
WHERE account_age_days < 30
  AND (check_deposit_count > 1 OR amount_micr_delta > 0)
ORDER BY check_deposit_count DESC, amount_micr_delta DESC

references: FBI IC3, 2024 Internet Crime Report — $483M in credit card and check fraud losses
USPS OIG, Mail Theft and Check Fraud Reports
Recorded Future, Annual Payment Fraud Intelligence Report 2025 — deurbanization trend
falsepositives: Legitimate re-deposit of returned checks (e.g., NSF item re-presented by payee)
Minor MICR encoding errors from check printing vendors on legitimate checks
Business customers with high-volume remote deposit capture processing
